One Patch fork release.

Download the APK from the assets below. Grant **Display over other apps** to use touch blocking.
Accessibility is optional and is needed for accessibility overlays and gesture replay.

This fork uses its own release signing certificate. It cannot update an upstream APK signed by
another author, or the locally installed debug build. Keep a copy of any settings you need before
switching installations; uninstalling an app removes its local settings.

The exported Quick Toggle still permits other apps to trigger the saved gesture while blocking
is active and Accessibility is enabled. Leave Accessibility off if you do not need that feature.

Verify downloaded files against the SHA-256 checksums attached to the release.
